Lesion Response
=============

The Lesion Response module tracks changes in lesions over time in response to treatment.

Data Collection Fields
--------------------

Basic Information
^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^
* **Lesion Link**: The specific lesion being assessed
* **Response Date**: When the response assessment was performed

Response Assessment
^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^
* **Response Type**: How the lesion has responded to treatment
    * Complete Response
    * Partial Response
    * Stable Disease
    * Progressive Disease

Residual Disease Measurements
^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^
* **Size Measurements**:
    * X-axis (residual width)
    * Y-axis (residual length)
    * Z-axis (residual depth)
    * Units of measurement
* **Volume**:
    * Residual volume measurement
    * Volume units

Special Considerations
--------------------

1. Measurement Standards:
    #. Use consistent measurement methods  
    #. Compare with baseline measurements  
    #. Document measurement technique  

2. Response Criteria:
    #. Follow standardized response criteria  
    #. Document basis for response assessment  
    #. Note any limitations in assessment
